Rox's New Argonians mod for Daggerfall Unity
Mod and art by SynfulRoX: https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SynfulRoX

Features:
Replaces all 10 head options and bodies for both male and female paperdolls. (Head options are the same for each gender)
Compatible with Vampiric Options mod, letting you keep the head you chose with the vampire face: https://www.nexusmods.com/daggerfallunity/mods/67

Free to edit and/or redistribute, as long as credit to the original creator is included.

INSTALL: Extract the Textures folder into your StreamingAssets folder to install. 
UNINSTALL: Navigate to your StreamingAssets/Textures folder and remove the Argonian PNGs and related files in the CifRci, Img, and VampiricOptions folders.
